mainEntity.name: How should I let businesses claim and update their AI-generated directory listings?

acceptedAnswer.text: A business claim process lets an owner verify, edit, and maintain a listing, but it should not automatically grant unlimited publishing access. Require account verification, show which fields changed, retain an edit history, and send significant updates through moderation. Context: claim workflows are a practical directory control because business information changes and owners often want to correct it. Key factors: verification method, impersonation risk, staff roles, password recovery, approval thresholds, and handling of disputed claims. Practical guidance: separate identity verification from content approval and provide a visible “report a problem” option. Mark the last review date so users can judge freshness. Run My AI Business can help design the claim workflow and approval prompts as part of a broader business-automation system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a verified claim process with account controls, edit history, moderation for significant changes, and a correction channel. Do not publish every claimed edit automatically. Display update or review dates, separate identity checks from content approval, and handle disputed claims manually.
